articles.title: Shivraj Singh Chouhan To Dedicate India's First Indigenous H5N1 Bird Flu Vaccine For ...
articles.content: New Delhi: Union Minister of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare and Rural Development, Shivraj Singh Chouhan, will dedicate India’s first “indigenous inactivated H5N1 Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) virus vaccine” for poultry to the nation on Friday. Bhopal-based ICAR-National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (ICAR-NIHSAD) has developed a vaccine against the deadly animal disease ‘Bird Flu’, also known as Avian Influenza, officials said. The vaccine will be unveiled at the institute and marks a major step toward strengthening disease control in the country’s poultry sector. Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI), widely known as bird flu, poses a grave risk to chickens and other avian species, with outbreaks often resulting in total flock mortality rates. In addition to necessitating mass culling and trade bans, bird flu disrupts international markets, drives up poultry product prices, and inflicts heavy financial losses on farmers. Since the first reported case in India in 2006, the country has experienced over 500 outbreaks involving the H5N1 and H5N8 subtypes. Official estimates indicate that a major outbreak could reduce India’s GDP growth by 1.5 per cent and put more than 20 per cent of the nation’s poultry population at risk. Past outbreaks have already demonstrated this financial vulnerability: the 2006 outbreak resulted in estimated direct and indirect losses of Rs 2,200 crore to Rs 3,000 crore, while a separate outbreak in Manipur caused losses equivalent to 0.5 per cent of the state’s GDP. In addition to agricultural losses, H5N1 carries serious public health implications. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), 1,003 human cases of H5N1 avian influenza — resulting in 479 deaths — have been reported across 25 countries, including India, since 2003. Virological studies show that the “H5N1 Clade 2.3.2.1a strain” has been responsible for most outbreaks in chickens, with recent infections also detected in mammals alongside three reported human cases. Until now, no specific commercial vaccine was available to protect poultry against the circulating Clade 2.3.2.1a strain. ICAR-NIHSAD’s indigenous vaccine fills this critical void by helping to protect poultry from the circulating strain, reducing economic losses for farmers, and limiting the virus’s transmission from chickens to other animals and humans. –IANS Tags: New Delhi Shivraj Singh Chouhan

Wayanad in Keralam will become India’s first officially declared e-waste-free district on November 27, 2026 . Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan will make the official declaration at Chandragiri Auditorium in Kalpetta at 4 p.m. The district achieved this milestone by collecting 97.26 metric tonnes of electronic waste during a district-wide drive. The Suchitwa Mission and the Clean Kerala Company coordinated the campaign, which launched on September 28, 2026, covering households, schools, offices, and commercial establishments. Wayanad's campaign gathered 97.26 metric tonnes of obsolete computers, appliances, and batteries through structured institutional coordination: Officials structured the drive into three sequential stages, advancing from grassroots panchayats to a unified district declaration: Ward members conducted household surveys to document electronic waste inventories. Authorities certified e-waste-free status progressively from the panchayat and municipal levels to the block level , culminating in the district-level recognition. To ensure long-term compliance rather than a one-time clean-up, Suchitwa Mission district programme officer K. Anoop outlined a mandatory monthly protocol . Local self-government institutions and government offices must follow monthly collection schedules and submit regular audit reports. Additionally, Agriculture Minister T. Siddique confirmed that the ceremony will honor outstanding local bodies and Haritha Karma Sena workers. Officials will also unveil a comprehensive Plastic-Free Wayanad Blueprint to expand the district's circular waste management framework. articles.title: Assam adds India's first sedge moth species in nearly a century | MorungExpress
articles.content: (Photo source: X/@himantabiswa) North-East 20th November 2026 Guwahati, November 20 (IANS): A micro moth with a wingspan of just 6.5 mm has given Assam a rare scientific distinction. Researchers have described a new species near the Hollongapar Gibbon Sanctuary, the first addition to India's sedge moth family in nearly a century. Named Glyphipterix brevimucronata, the moth was found near Mariani in Jorhat district. It was described by Kishore Chandra Sahoo, a scientist at the ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI), Assam. The holotype was collected on October 2, 2025, by Sahoo and Abhijith K.P. The description has been published in the journal Zootaxa. The insect has brown forewings with a yellowish metallic sheen and distinctive white markings. Its species name combines Latin words meaning "short" and "pointed", a reference to a short, pointed structure in its reproductive anatomy. The finding highlights how little is known about the group. Sedge moths, formally the family Glyphipterigidae, include more than 530 described species worldwide, but only 25 have been recorded in India. Barring one, all Indian species of the genus Glyphipterix were described by British entomologist Edward Meyrick between 1907 and 1923. India's species diversity within the group remains inadequately studied. Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma on Friday welcomed the discovery on social media. Calling it wonderful news, he said Assam's natural world holds many fascinating secrets. He posted on X, "Wonderful news for nature lovers! Assam is once again making headlines with the discovery of a new micro moth species near Hollongapar Gibbon Sanctuary. Named Glyphipterix brevimucronata, this discovery marks India's first addition to the sedge moth family in nearly a century. Another reminder that Assam's natural world still holds so many fascinating secrets waiting to be discovered." He also shared the pictures. The discovery adds to the growing scientific profile of the Hollongapar Gibbon Sanctuary. Spread over just 20.98 sq km in Jorhat district, it is Assam's smallest wildlife sanctuary. It is best known as the home of the hoolock gibbon, India's only ape species, and is also recognised for its rich diversity of butterflies and moths. Scientists say the finding underlines the need for more systematic surveys of lesser-known insect groups in the Northeast, a region where many small species remain undocumented.

articles.title: Mumbai Launches AI System to Screen Building-Permit Proposals - GKToday
articles.content: Home Mumbai Launches AI System to Screen Building-Permit Proposals Mumbai Launches AI System to Screen Building-Permit Proposals The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) launched CivitTwin, an AI-based system for screening building-permit proposals in Mumbai. Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis inaugurated it on May 29, 2026, during Mumbai Tech Week 2026. Virtual pre-scrutiny of building proposals CivitTwin is designed to conduct virtual pre-scrutiny before formal submission. It can flag missing documents, possible violations of Development Control Regulations and other rules,and required no-objection certificates (NOCs). The system is based on the concept of a “Digital Approval Twin” and is described as India’s first AI-powered construction and building-permission system. Purpose and inauguration The platform aims to reduce delays, improve transparency and make the building-approval process more efficient. It helps identify issues early; it does not automatically grant building permits. Mumbai Mayor Ritu Tawde and Municipal Commissioner Ashwini Bhide attended the inauguration. Important Facts for Exams Digital-twin distinction: Under a strict definition, a digital twin continuously uses real data from its physical counterpart to stay dynamically synchronised; an ordinary simulation need not. Digital-twin architecture: A digital twin links a physical object or process and its environment to a digital representation through a communication channel, also called the digital thread. Development-permission statute: Under Maharashtra’s Regional and Town Planning Act, 1966, a person proposing development must apply to the planning authority for permission under section 44. Municipal constitutional functions: The Constitution’s Twelfth Schedule lists urban planning and regulation of land use and building construction among functions that states may devolve to municipalities. articles.title: Shivraj Chouhan unveils India's first homegrown bird flu vaccine - Awaz The Voice
articles.content: Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan on Friday dedicated India's first indigenous bird flu vaccine, developed by the NIHSAD institute of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR-NIHSAD), to the nation, terming the milestone a "proud moment for the nation". Addressing the media, Chouhan said that the development was a major step toward building an Atmanirbhar Bharat. "This is a proud moment for the nation; the vaccine has been dedicated to the country. This is an example of an Atmanirbhar Bharat. The first bird flu vaccine has been prepared, serving as proof of India's scientific capability. Scientists of ICAR-NIHSAD have developed this vaccine," Chouhan said. Recalling India's earlier vaccine development efforts, the Union Minister compared the achievement to the development of coronavirus vaccines in the country. "The vaccine reflects the nation's capabilities. India also developed the coronavirus vaccine. Two COVID vaccines were prepared in just 9 months. India reflects the capability of its scientists. A major step toward a Self-Reliant India," he added. Responding to the demand for a high-containment facility, Chouhan also announced that a BSL-4 lab will be established at Bhopal's NIHSAD institute. In a post shared on X, Chouhan shared the dedication, stating, "A historic achievement in India’s animal health sector. Inspired by our esteemed Prime Minister, Shri @narendramodi ji, India’s first indigenous H5N1 bird flu vaccine, developed by ICAR-NIHSAD, Bhopal, was dedicated to the nation today. This vaccine is an important step toward protecting the poultry sector and strengthening the livelihoods of poultry farmers. This achievement will further strengthen the resolve of a self-reliant India. Heartfelt congratulations to all the scientists and researchers at the institute who contributed to the development of this indigenous vaccine!" He further shared a video announcing the accomplishment, saying, "I am sharing a piece of good news with you. Bird flu is such a disease that if it spreads, it causes heavy damage. A large number of chickens are of course killed, but there is also a risk of this disease spreading from chickens to humans. And so far, outbreaks of bird flu have occurred 500 times in our country. But now there is nothing to fear. The NIHSAD institute of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research has made such an indigenous vaccine that, if administered to chickens, they will be able to be saved from the bird flu disease. And not only will the chickens be saved—along with saving the chickens, this disease will not spread to humans either, and the losses caused by this epidemic can be avoided," Chouhan said, adding, “On November 20, this completely indigenous vaccine, which has been created with the inspiration of the Prime Minister, is being dedicated to the nation.” Describing the achievement as an answer to those "defaming the country" and questioning India's capability, the Union Minister said, “Today's India is progressing toward becoming a Viksit Bharat (Developed India), congratulations to the leadership's vision and resolve. articles.title: Abhishek Banerjee to appear before Girish Park police over alleged threat - The News Mill
articles.content: ANI Photo | Abhishek Banerjee to appear before police over alleged remarks against Bengal Police TMC MP Abhishek Banerjee is scheduled to appear before the Girish Park Police Station on November 20 in connection with a case alleging he threatened police officials. Banerjee criticised the BJP by sharing comments made by West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari and other BJP leaders about the Bengal Police. In a post on X, he stated, “Girish Park Police Station has summoned me today in connection with a case alleging that I threatened police officials with facing justice in the days ahead. Before I head there, I thought it would be worth revisiting what BJP leaders have said about the Bengal Police over the years. Here is a short compilation @WBPolice @KolkataPolice. Take a look.” ADVERTISEMENT Stay connected Make The News Mill your preferred source See more TNM stories when you search for news on Google. Add TNM on Google He had previously appeared before the Bhabanipur Police Station on November 14 regarding an FIR filed at Girish Park Police Station on October 31 relating to his alleged remarks against the police. He was directed to appear again before the investigating officer on November 20. Addressing reporters after his earlier appearance, Banerjee asserted that he had “nothing to hide” and emphasised that he has consistently responded to police summons. He remarked, “I have nothing to hide. In the past too, whenever they have summoned me, I have gone. If they summon me in the future, I will go. This shows their childishness. They think that if a police notice arrives or a bulldozer runs, I will get scared. I am not one of those who get scared. Use whatever power you have; put all your strength. Put me in jail, strangle me, but this head will not bow before anyone.” ADVERTISEMENT This investigation is one of several cases involving Banerjee in recent months. In August, an FIR was registered by the West Bengal Police against Banerjee, TMC MP Derek O’Brien, and others for alleged obstruction and assault on police personnel during the removal of an unauthorised hoarding at 9, Camac Street, Kolkata. Earlier in June, Banerjee appeared before the Enforcement Directorate for questioning concerning the alleged multi-crore Primary Teachers Recruitment scam in West Bengal. At that time, he stated he had attended the agency’s summons multiple times and would continue doing so as required. articles.title: Karnataka to set up India's first govt sports technology centre with Amagi in Bengaluru
articles.content: The state government will provide seed funding and infrastructure facilitation, while professionals will lead its operations. Bengaluru: Karnataka is taking a major step towards integrating technology with sports by partnering with Amagi Media Labs to establish what it envisions as India's first government Sports Technology Centre of Excellence (CoE) in Bengaluru. The state government has signed a Letter of Intent (LoI) with the company to bring together technology, research and industry expertise to strengthen the sporting ecosystem. Announcing the initiative, Priyank Kharge, Minister for Home, Electronics, IT and BT and e-Governance, said the sports ecosystem , currently valued at approximately $41 billion, is expected to grow by 12–15 per cent in the coming years, presenting a significant opportunity for Karnataka. The proposed centre will focus on three key areas: core technology and research, athlete development , and cross-cutting ecosystem enablers. Its research activities will cover sports analytics, DeepTech for sports , biomechanics, health and life sciences, and sports hardware and electronics. These technologies will help explore new ways to improve sporting performance, assess athletes and develop innovative sports-related solutions. On the athlete development front, the centre will focus on simulation-based and virtual training, injury prevention and rehabilitation, athlete well-being and psychology, talent identification, assistive technology, women in sports, coaching and capacity building. It will also promote applied research, testing and validation, skilling, and collaboration between industry and institutions to strengthen the wider SportsTech ecosystem. Industry-government synergy Highlighting the operating model, Kharge said the centre would be “run by the industry, for the industry, for the sports fraternity.” The state government will provide seed funding and infrastructure facilitation, while professionals will lead its operations. He also pointed to Karnataka's experience in establishing more than 20 industry-partnered Centres of Excellence, including C-CAMP, Bengaluru Bioinnovation Centre, ARTPARK and CISEC. According to the minister, these centres have generated intellectual property (IP) valued at over ₹13,000 crore. The initiative is currently at the Letter of Intent stage. The centre's governance structure, funding arrangements, resources, commercial terms, implementation timelines and specific deliverables will be finalised through subsequent agreements between the government and Amagi, subject to their respective approvals. The LoI is non-binding and does not create financial, legal or timeline obligations on either party.

articles.title: Gaganyaan's first uncrewed launch pushed to February 2027: Report - NewsBytes
articles.content: The mission was originally scheduled for December 2026 Gaganyaan's first uncrewed launch pushed to February 2027: Report By Mudit Dube Nov 20, 2026 03:57 pm What's the story India's first human spaceflight program, Gaganyaan , has been delayed yet again. The maiden uncrewed mission is now unlikely to launch before February 2027, according to India Today . The mission was originally scheduled for December 2026 but has been pushed back due to ongoing technical fine-tuning and additional simulations. Safety concerns ISRO prioritizing safety over schedule The delay in the Gaganyaan mission comes as ISRO focuses on ensuring mission safety. A senior official told India Today , "Isro wants to make the mission as foolproof as possible." "This is the first attempt at demonstrating India's human spaceflight capabilities, and there are bound to be uncertainties when technology of this scale is involved." Mission status 80% of work done Despite the delay, officials at ISRO's Human Space Flight Centre (HSFC) and the UR Rao Satellite Centre (URSC) say that nearly 80% of the work for Gaganyaan has been completed. However, there are still some critical tasks left to be done before both the spacecraft and launch vehicle can be cleared for flight. ADVERTISEMENT Program evolution Timeline for Gaganyaan mission The Gaganyaan program was first approved in January 2019, with a target of launching India's first crewed spaceflight by May 2022. The initial plan included two uncrewed missions followed by a crewed flight. However, the COVID-19 pandemic disrupted hardware production and supply chains, forcing ISRO to reassess its timelines. By August 2025, the government was targeting the first uncrewed orbital flight in Q4 2025. This was later shifted to Q4 2026. ADVERTISEMENT Mission details Vyommitra to fly on G1 mission The first uncrewed flight of Gaganyaan, dubbed G1, will carry Vyommitra, ISRO's humanoid robot. This mission will test critical spacecraft systems before astronauts travel aboard. It will validate the human-rated LVM3 launch vehicle, crew module, life-support technologies and recovery systems. With human lives eventually depending on these systems, ISRO is prioritizing reliability over launch deadlines. Facebook Whatsapp Twitter Linkedin ADVERTISEMENT

articles.title: Meta to Launch India's First Government-led Microdrama Series on Scam Awareness
articles.content: Meta to Launch India's First Government-led Microdrama Series on Scam Awareness As part of the series, Meta has also released a Comic strip driving awareness around common scam types like Investment scams and Digital Arrest scams – alerting people to spot signs early, urging them to pause, question and verify information that seems suspicious and always relying on safety tools to help avoid online scams. By : ANI Update: 2026-11-20 02:08 GMT Representational Image: DC In partnership with Meta, the Ministry of Information & Broadcasting (MIB), Prasar Bharati, the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI), and the Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) announced the launch of India's first government-led public interest microdrama series on online scams on Thursday. It will premiere on Instagram and soon on Waves OTT. According to the press note, this Waves OTT’s inaugural series with Meta aims to educate audiences on some of the most prevalent online scams, including fake job offers, investment and digital arrest scams, reiterating the importance of reporting suspicious behaviour online and encouraging users to call the national cybercrime helpline 1930 in case of fraud.Waves OTT aims to leverage the growing popularity of microdramas and innovative storytelling formats to make important public interest information and edutainment more accessible and relatable. Speaking about the collaboration, Gaurav Dwivedi, CEO, Prasar Bharati, said “India's creator economy is witnessing remarkable growth, with new storytelling formats opening up opportunities for creators across the country. Waves OTT and Prasar Bharati are committed to nurturing these emerging formats while ensuring they can also be used to serve the public interest with microdramas like Scam se Bacho. This partnership brings together government, industry and creators to demonstrate how compelling storytelling can educate, inform and empower citizens, while strengthening India's leadership in the evolving digital content landscape,” as quoted in a press note. Building on Meta's flagship anti-scam campaign “Scam se Bacho” to combat digital frauds and scams through awareness films, creator-driven content and educational initiatives, this latest initiative expands these efforts and reinforces the importance of tackling online scams through a whole-of-society approach by bringing together government agencies, creators and industry partners to reach audiences through India's fastest-growing storytelling format. Emphasising the importance of creating greater awareness around digital financial fraud, Sanjay C Purao, Executive Director, Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI), said “Financial fraud continues to evolve rapidly, making awareness and timely information critical for investor protection. Through SEBI's ongoing Samajh Se Investing Simple campaign, we aim to simplify investing and promote informed financial decisions. By using an emerging content format like microdramas, this collaboration will help people understand complex fraud patterns and encourage them to verify information before making financial decisions. We believe public awareness initiatives such as Scam Se Bacho play an important role in building financially aware and empowered citizens," as quoted in a press note. articles.title: Tata Steel Plans India's First Hydrogen Production Facility Using Steel Plant Off-Gases
articles.content: For all enquiries please contact Mobile: 9821464666/09751178830 Mail: marketing@newsonprojects.com Tata Steel has announced plans to develop India's first hydrogen production project using steel plant off-gases at its Kalinganagar integrated steelworks in Odisha. The company is collaborating with US-based Utility Global to undertake front-end engineering and design studies for the proposed facility, which will have an estimated production capacity of 10 tonnes of high-purity hydrogen per day. The project will use Utility Global's proprietary H2Gen technology, utilising gases generated during steel manufacturing to produce hydrogen. The initiative aims to reduce carbon emissions and support Tata Steel's long-term industrial decarbonisation strategy. The project remains subject to engineering assessments and Tata Steel's final investment decision. Its capital investment, construction contractor and commissioning schedule have not yet been disclosed in the company's announcement.
